info.text:
About two-thirds of Spotify's music money goes to rights holders.
Spotify says it paid the music industry more than $11B in 2025.
Podcasts and audiobooks skip per-stream label royalties; US Premium ($12.99) includes 15 hours of audiobook listening a month.
Over 500M users had streamed a video podcast (Spotify, May 2026). Operating income: -EUR 659M in 2022, EUR 2.2B in 2025. Gross margin: record 33.4% in Q2 2026 (as of mid-2026).
Sources: Spotify shareholder decks (SEC 6-K), Spotify Loud & Clear, Spotify newsroom.
News and education, not financial advice.
